interface.signature: fullText: str, searchText: str, allowOverlap: bool = True

postconditions.description: If searchText is an empty string, the function should return 0.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(fullText) - len(searchText) + 1) if fullText[i:i+len(searchText)] == searchText)
postconditions.description: The function should return the number of non-overlapping occurrences of searchText in fullText if allowOverlap is False.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(fullText)) if fullText[i:i+len(searchText)] == searchText)
postconditions.description: The function should return the number of overlapping occurrences of searchText in fullText if allowOverlap is True.
